responsibilities: Design and build scalable data pipelines and business-conformed dimensional data marts in collaboration with Data Science, Engineering, Product, and Operations departments
Support the development and adoption of agentic tooling. We have our own AI Data Analyst (Hermes) and dbt Agent (Ralph) that are built and managed by our Analytics Engineers
Support self-service analytics workflows, Analytics Engineering skills, and dimensional data principles through implementation, education, and peer support
Help us implement the data and analytics products we’ll need to effect our bank charter
Contribute to the evolution of our data quality, governance, and security strategies
Contribute to our definition of Analytics Engineering standards and best practices

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Your curiosity and bias toward action will drive meaningful impact as you build durable data products, unlock faster experimentation
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Speed phrases ("help us accelerate", "bias toward action", "faster experimentation", "ship") sit alongside reliability, trust, quality, governance and strong tests, at less than two to one, so it is mixed.
evidence.domain_risk: Help us implement the data and analytics products we’ll need to effect our bank charter
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: A fintech building the data products for a bank charter, with compliance named in the requirements, so it is high.
evidence.data_team_maturity: You’ll join a team of high-performing Data and Analytics Engineers building the shared foundations
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: An existing team that already runs its own AI analyst and dbt agent on a full modern stack is a mid-stage, growing function.
evidence.jd_authorship: We have our own AI Data Analyst (Hermes) and dbt Agent (Ralph) that are built and managed by our Analytics Engineers
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Bullets name the team's own agents, dimensional marts and the bank charter, so a reader knows the day-to-day work.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: building the shared foundations that power decisioning, automation, and measurement across the company
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The role builds shared marts, self-service workflows and agent tooling for data consumers across the company.
evidence.autonomy_level: Contribute to our definition of Analytics Engineering standards and best practices
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: Most bullets are support, help and contribute; no bullet has the role setting direction, so it is execution.
evidence.ai_role: Support the development and adoption of agentic tooling. We have our own AI Data Analyst (Hermes) and dbt Agent (Ralph) that are built and managed by our Analytics Engineers
evidence.ai_role_explanation: Analytics engineers build and manage the AI analyst and dbt agent, and the candidate also uses AI agents, so the tie-breaker gives ai_enabler.
evidence.testing_framing: Contribute to the evolution of our data quality, governance, and security strategies
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Data quality strategy is a responsibility, and the fit list asks for "strong tests".
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: Teams, models, and AI agents need data that they can find, understand, and trust.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Trust and the bank charter are named, but the posting is dominated by building and accelerating, so it is moderate.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: We are building an AI-native data platform
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: New platform and charter products are built alongside an existing stack and team.
evidence.loss_aversion: data that they can find, understand, and trust — trust is named but secondary to delivery.
